# Sri Sai Dharma Samrakshana Prema Kuteeram

> A registered charitable trust serving with love through seva, devotion, and community.

## About

Sri Sai Dharma Samrakshana Prema Kuteeram is a Public Charitable Trust registered at Melakarur, Karur (Document No. 51/2026, dated 02/07/2026). The trust is founded and managed by Shri S. Govindaraj, with 12 Board of Trustees overseeing spiritual, seva, education, communications, publications, and administrative activities.

## Trust Details

- **Full Name:** Sri Sai Dharma Samrakshana Prema Kuteeram Public Charitable Trust
- **Registration:** Melakarur, Karur — Document No. 51/2026, dated 02/07/2026
- **Settlor & Managing Trustee:** Shri S. Govindaraj
- **Registered Office:** No.104, Mettu Street, Karur – 639001, Tamil Nadu, India

## Pages

- **Home:** pages/index.html — Mission overview with animated flow tree of trustees and activities
- **About:** pages/about.html — Trust background, philosophy, and guiding principles
- **Trustees:** pages/trustees.html — Interactive tree view of all 12 Board of Trustees and their responsibilities
- **Gallery:** pages/gallery.html — Event and seva photo documentation
- **Events:** pages/events.html — Bhajans, seva, study circle calendar and event bookings
- **Discourses:** pages/discourse.html — Weekly messages archive
- **Seva:** pages/seva.html — Donations and monthly subscriptions
- **Dashboard:** pages/dashboard.html — Member portal with membership card, daily blessings, and donations
- **Login / Signup / Reset:** pages/login.html / pages/signup.html / pages/reset-password.html — Authentication pages

## Board of Trustees (12 Members)

1. **Sri Sai Prakash** — Spiritual Activities (Guru Purnima, Ganapathi Homam, Gayatri Homam, Sai Jayanthi, Rudra Japam, Monthly Amavasya Tarpanam, Annual Thithi/Shraddha) & Seva (Grocery aid, Temple support, Veda students, Diwali clothing)
2. **Sri Sathyamoorthy** — Spiritual Activities (Rathakalpa Pooja, Sathyanarayana Pooja, Navami Jayanthis, Karthigai Deepam, Sankaranthi, Maha Periyava & Sai Jayanthi) & Communications (Website, Social media, Digital comms, Media relations)
3. **Dr. Sri Chandrasekaran** — Spiritual (Sannyastha Mahalayam, Aradhanas), Seva (Family welfare, Veda school, Old-age home, Temple service, Tree planting), Education (Career guidance, Health programs)
4. **Sri Hariharan** — Spiritual (Aradhana Mahotsavams), Seva (Old-age home, Temple service), Publications (Deivathin Kural, Maha Periyava teachings, Audio/Video releases)
5. **Sri Prem Sai** — Spiritual (Nagara Sankeerthanam, Special bhajans, Narayana Seva), Seva (Veda school, Old-age home), Education (Satsangs, Spiritual classes)
6. **Sri Amarnath** — Spiritual Activities (Nagara Sankeerthanam, Special bhajans with Sri Prem Sai)
7. **Mrs. Sridevi Sairam** — Education (Satsangs with Sri Prem Sai & Sri Darshan Sairam)
8. **Dr. Srividya Sairam** — Education (Spiritual classes with Sri Prem Sai)
9. **Sri Sathyanarayanan Sairam** — Education & Awareness (Career guidance, Health/hygiene programs with Dr. Chandrasekaran)
10. **Mrs. Nithya Hariharan** — Spiritual Publications (Deivathin Kural, Maha Periyava teachings, Audio/Video/E-publications with Sri Hariharan)
11. **Sri Prasad Sairam** — Administration (Fundraising, Donor coordination, Income-expenditure accounts, Financial management)
12. **Sri Darshan Sairam** — Education (Satsangs) & Communications (Website, Social media, Digital comms, Graphic design, Trust publications with Sri Sathyamoorthy)

## Trust Objects

- Education aid for poor children
- Veda training and scholarships
- Poor feeding (Anna Dana)
- Orphanages and old-age homes
- Gosamrakshana (cow protection / Goshalas)
- Veda Patasalas
- Temple renovation and maintenance
- Medical assistance
- Yoga and wellness programs
- Other charitable activities (non-profit, service-motive only, confined to India)

## Spiritual Lineage

The trust draws inspiration from:
- **Sri Sathya Sai Baba** — Universal love, selfless service, education values
- **Kanchi Maha Periyava (Sri Chandrashearendra Saraswati)** — Sanatana Dharma, Vedic traditions

## Guiding Principles

- **Love All, Serve All** — Core philosophy
- Sarva Loka Sukhino Bhavantu — May all beings everywhere be happy and free
- Non-profit, service-motive activities only
- Confined to operations within India

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: Static HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Supabase (Auth, Database, Realtime)
- Payments: Razorpay (Donations, Memberships)
- Deployment: Vercel (Serverless Functions, Routing)
- Automation: Telegram Bot, Vercel Serverless APIs
